description: This file defines a custom exception class 'MigrationException' within the OrangeHRM installer namespace, used to handle migration-related errors in the OrangeHRM HRM system.

classes.name: MigrationException
classes.description: A custom exception class extending PHP's Exception class, used specifically to represent migration-related errors in the OrangeHRM installer context.

methods.name: previousMigrationIncomplete
methods.description: A static method that returns an instance of MigrationException with a message indicating that the previous migration was incomplete.

calls: new self('The previous migration is incomplete.')
